He's gonna make it rain!|audio = PlsDonateWave20.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] and [[Dispatcher|Dispatcher]] on Wave 20 ([[Pls Donate]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' internally referred to as '''Hazem Boss''', was the final boss of [[Pls Donate]], the event map for the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It moved quite slowly, but had the highest health out of any enemy in the event. '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' had three abilities that could be used at any time: #Its first ability was ''Make It Rain'' where it would spawn 20 robux out of the sky that upon landing, would explode, stunning any towers for 1.5 seconds and dealing 100 damage units by 100 damage. #Its second ability was ''Greed's Smite'' where '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' took out its hammer and slammed it onto the ground, stunning towers for 3 seconds and damaging units caught within the hammer radius by 100 damage. #Its third and final ability was ''Cat Summon'' where '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' summoned ten [[Bloated]] [[Cat]]s with a delay of 0.3 seconds between each spawn. ==Appearance== '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' was a large version of {{RLinkU|haz3mn|Hazem}} corrupted by a [[God Cube]] shard. It had grey skin, purple torso and blue pants, with dark purple cracks on its arms and glowing purple cracks near the hands. It wore a purple sparkle-time fedora with dark purple hair underneath, and it had glowing yellow dollar sign eyes. A [[Cat]] sat on its fedora. It wielded a large purple and grey hammer, which it dragged across the path. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Mercenary Base]], [[Engineer]] or [[Turret]] are most effective against this. **As the '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' gives quite a lot of cash while being damaged, they can be afforded quite easily. **Support towers like the [[DJ Booth]] or [[Commander]] can be used to boost the statistics of these towers. *AOE towers, like the [[Mortar]] or [[Pyromancer]], can be used to help clear out the [[Cat]]s that '''Corrupted Haz3mn''' summons, though they are not necessary. *The [[Medic]] can be brought to cleanse the stuns applied by '''Corrupted Haz3mn''', though as they are quite short this is not necessary. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CorruptedHaz3mnWalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) CorruptedHaz3mnRain.gif|''Make It Rain'' animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) CorruptedHaz3mnSlam.gif|''Greed's Smite'' animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) CorruptedHaz3mnSummon.gif|''Cat Summon'' animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) CorruptedHaz3mnDeath.gif|Death animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} PlsDonateUpdateIcon.png|'''Corrupted Haz3mn''' on the game icon. PlsDonateBadge.png|'''Corrupted Haz3mn''' on the first version of the Pls Donate badge. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy's appearance is based on {{RLinkU|haz3mn|Hazem}}, the creator of '''PLS DONATE'''. *'''Corrupted Haz3mn's''' internal name is ''Hazem Boss''. **Because of this, all the enemies it summoned were called "''Hazem Boss's _____''" instead of "''Corrupted Haz3mn's _____''". *'''Corrupted Haz3mn's''' theme uses vocals which were sampled from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BS46C2z5lVE My Love] by Route 94, more specifically, the "''made with the warmth of my''" lyrics. *Upon death, the [[Cat]] seen on '''Corrupted Haz3mn's''' hat bounced away.
